author: jamesbaker
text: My homework with explanations at each point A) First DBR B) First RBD (There is a reaction that brings price back to the first demand zone, price flags after touching demand creating a small demand zone on top) Prices reaction to this demand zone cuts through supply at B and this becomes demand C) RBD with a FTB bringing price back to the flag made on top of demand zone at A D) Price reacts to this demand moves away before a FTB pinbar - price easily cuts through supply at C E) RBD - followed by compression down to flip zone from supply at C - from here there is a strong bull move in price that easily breaks supply at E and this becomes demand F) Price is capped and following the indecision there is a RBD formed G) FTB to the strong level created after compression from E H) Price moves up to H where its the FTB to new FTR (plays within this PAZ) I) Bulls are now in control and price is easily able to move down to the price cap at the bottom with a small speed bump from demand at D G) New supply formed where there was previously supply to the left Thanks in advance for all the help!
